[P2] 我是数学迷
水晶球与
除法魔杖
（美）帕姆·卡尔弗特 著
（美）韦恩·古享 绘
丁蔚 译
外语教学与研究出版社
北京

[P4] “小零！小零！”一大早，彼得王子就在四处寻找他的小狗。今天早上，小零刨出了乘法魔杖，之后竟然和魔杖一起不见了。“万一乘法魔杖落入坏人手里，后果将不堪设想。”彼得越想越着急。
彼得经过一个农场，看到奶牛群里有5只非常奇怪的动物在吃草。这些动物既像奶牛，又像青蛙，其中1只“青蛙奶牛”看到彼得还停下来，呱地叫了一声。
“这是什么动物啊？是不是奶牛吃错东西才变成这个样子的？”彼得觉得非常惊讶。

[P5] 正在这时，彼得突然听到一阵尖叫声，“天哪，我的孩子怎么变成青蛙了！”彼得赶紧跑过去一看，只见前面路上有2只孩子大小的青蛙围着1位女士和6个孩子跳来跳去。

[P6] “不，不可能……他已经被囚禁起来了。”彼得突然想到了那个拿着乘法魔杖在王国里兴风作浪的侏儒怪。他有些不安，犹豫了一会儿，决定还是先回王宫的城堡里。“不管怎样，得先把这些怪事告诉父亲。”彼得心想。

[P7] 来到城堡的大门前，彼得看到负责守卫城堡的12位骑士站在那儿。彼得正想过去跟骑士们打个招呼，突然间，地面剧烈地晃动起来。
随着砰的一声巨响，12位骑士中的4位竟然变成了4只穿着锃亮盔甲的青蛙！
“难道侏儒怪真的回来了？”彼得更加疑惑，急忙冲进了城堡里。
彼得跑到大厅里，看见母亲正在大哭，腿上还趴着一只大青蛙。

[P8] “母亲，父亲去哪儿了？”彼得见到青蛙，更着急了。
“他……他又变成了青蛙……”
“又？”彼得很惊讶。
“嗯，你父亲还是王子的时候，被一个叫玛蒂尔达的女巫施魔法变成了青蛙。后来一位公主亲吻了他，才解除了魔法。我刚才也吻了他，可这次吻他也不管用了。”
“等等……一位公主亲吻了父亲？”
“是你父亲遇见我之前的事，那件事说来话长。”

[P9] “哦……这么说来，这次不是侏儒怪搞的鬼？”
“应该不是。瞧，你父亲的 12 位大臣正准备出发去找
玛蒂尔达呢！”王后把彼得带到了阳台上。12 位大臣骑着
马正要出发。
“不是一共有 24 位大臣吗？其他 12 位呢？”
“他们……他们也变成了青蛙。”王后说着又哭了起来。

[P10] 彼得越想越觉得事态严重。如果女巫用的是乘法魔杖，那24位大臣与1/2相乘后，应该有12位大臣消失，而不是变成青蛙。人怎么会变成青蛙呢？难道是被施了某种更邪恶的魔法？不行，一定要想办法阻止女巫！

[P11] 彼得首先来到了城堡里的沼泽地，这里有很多青蛙，可都是些普通的青蛙，没什么怪异之处。就在他准备离开的时候，忽然听到旁边的一个洞穴里传来一阵熟悉的怪笑声。彼得蹑手蹑脚地朝声音传来的方向走去。
“玛蒂尔达，你的青蛙水晶球真是太厉害了！要是只用除法魔杖，哪儿能引起这么大的骚动啊！”是侏儒怪的声音！
“要不了多久，我们就能把整个王国变成一个青蛙王国啦！哈哈哈！”女巫的声音尖锐刺耳。

[P12] “原来是这两个人一起搞的鬼！”彼得心想。顺着侏儒怪的目光，彼得看到女巫手上拿着一个闪闪发亮的水晶球，看起来非常诡异。侏儒怪的手里握着一根魔杖。这根魔杖和乘法魔杖一样，上面也刻着一个符号。不过不是代表乘法的×，而是一条短线，短线上下各有一个圆点。
“没错！那个爱管闲事的彼得竟敢把我们困在‘0之深渊’，真是太可恶了。我们很快就可以报仇了！”侏儒怪嘎嘎地笑起来。
“他们一定猜不到，你的数学魔法能帮我们从那个鬼地方逃出来。”女巫说。
“等抓到了那小子，我一定要好好儿教训教训他……”

[P13] “侏儒怪！我们说好的，那小子归我！你看，现在女巫都流行吃青蛙王子。”女巫说着，把一本杂志伸到侏儒怪面前，“杂志上说了，青蛙王子不仅味道鲜美，而且能让皮肤变得光滑细嫩……”
“放心吧。我会把彼得王子交给你的——而且，马上就交给你！”
彼得还没反应过来，就被眨眼间来到他身后的侏儒怪推到了女巫面前。
潮流杂志
一本专门为潮流人士准备的杂志
最美味的青蛙王子
满足你的胃口
滋润你的皮肤
提升你的气质

[P14] “放开我！”彼得挣扎着喊道。
“脾气真暴躁，简直跟他父亲一模一样。”女巫怪笑着，舔了舔嘴唇，“我要把他做成一道独一无二的美味大餐。”
侏儒怪也跟着笑了起来，“不过，我得先向他要一件东西。”
“我们说好了，他归我！”女巫不满地叫道，“现在我就要把他炖成汤喝了！”，

“玛蒂尔达，乘法魔杖还在他手里呢！要是把乘法魔杖和我们手里的除法魔杖联合起来，那我们就所向无敌了。到时候，我们会拥有强大的乘除魔法，没有人能够阻挡我们！”接着，侏儒怪又不情愿地加了一句，“到时候我保证让你先用。”
“那好吧！”女巫转过身，盯着彼得恶狠狠地问道：“快说！乘法魔杖在哪儿？”
“我不会告诉你们的！”彼得大声回答道。

[P15] “你会说的。”说着，侏儒怪对着水晶球挥了挥除法魔杖。透过水晶球，彼得看见小零正在城堡附近的一个巷子里嗅来嗅去。“小狗小狗，除以1！”话音刚落，就看见可怜的小零变成了一只又像青蛙又像狗的“青蛙狗”。“快把它变回去！”彼得激动地冲侏儒怪喊道。“把乘法魔杖给我，我就把它变回去。”侏儒怪说。

[P16] “你们不是有水晶球吗？为什么不让它告诉你们乘法魔杖在哪儿？”彼得反问道。
“我亲爱的王子，水晶球只能看到有生命的东西。”女巫没好气儿地说，“我只是一名女巫，可没法儿让不可能的事情变成可能！”
“什么坏事你没干过？把奶牛都弄得呱呱叫了。”彼得小声嘀咕道。
彼得转身对侏儒怪和女巫说：“你们先带我去找小零，只有它知道乘法魔杖在哪儿。”
彼得并不想把乘法魔杖交给侏儒怪和女巫，但他只能先想办法离开这里。

[P17] “好！”侏儒怪说着，把水晶球放到魔杖顶上，“你要是敢耍花样，我就把你也变成青蛙，一辈子都休想变回来！”
女巫在一旁咯咯坏笑，“侏儒怪，你可别吓坏了可爱的王子！”
三个人走出洞穴，去找小零。一路上，侏儒怪都在用水晶球和除法魔杖取乐。“屠夫夫妇屠夫夫妇，除以2！”他刚说完，屠夫的妻子就变成了一只大青蛙，冲着自己的丈夫呱呱直叫。
屠夫吓得都快昏过去了。

[P18] 不一会儿，他们又看到了一个小女孩儿，她正在和 12 只小猫玩耍。
“小猫小猫，除以 3！”侏儒怪喊道。瞬间，其中 4 只小猫变成了呱呱叫的“青蛙猫”。
“侏儒怪每次除以的数都不一样。他是怎么知道应该除以几的？”彼得很纳闷儿。
看着那些小猫，彼得忽然明白了。12 只小猫可以分成 3 组，每组 4 只。侏儒怪将人或动物分成数量相等的若干组，然后用总数除以组数，其中一组就会变成“青蛙怪”！

[P19] 很快，侏儒怪又将除法魔杖对准了一个小马童，
他正忙着把马赶进马厩里。
“侏儒怪，让我试试！”女巫不满地喊道。
“你根本不会用除法魔杖！”侏儒怪说。

[P20] 女巫不管三七二十一，一把抢过除法魔杖。“这能有多难？看见那匹马了吗？”她把除法魔杖对准一匹马，念道：“马儿马儿，除以1/4！”只见那匹马立刻变成了4匹“青蛙马”。小小的“青蛙马”追着小马童蹦了出来，吓得小马童到处跑。
彼得疑惑地挠了挠后脑勺。为什么除以分数后反而出现了更多的“青蛙马”呢？很快，他就发现，这4匹“青蛙马”的大小只有原先那匹马的1/4。
“快把除法魔杖还给我！”说着，侏儒怪便向女巫扑了过去。

[P21] 女巫迅速跳到一边，躲开了侏儒怪。“我再玩会儿！”
说着，她把除法魔杖对准2只小猪，兴奋地念道：“小猪
小猪，除以1/5！”顿时，草地上出现了10只呱呱叫的
“青蛙小猪”。女巫盯着它们，口水都要流出来了。“不知
道这些小东西炖成汤味道怎么样……”
就在女巫出神的瞬间，侏儒怪一把将水晶球从除法
魔杖上拿了下来，大声嚷道：“不要再变了！我受够这些
青蛙了！”

[P22] 见水晶球被夺走了，女巫生气地将除法魔杖丢到一边，大叫着朝侏儒怪冲了过去。两个人很快就厮打起来。就在这时，彼得趁机捡起除法魔杖飞快地逃走了。
彼得一口气跑到了水晶球里出现的那条小巷里，小零果然还在那里。看到自己的小主人，小零呱呱地叫了几声。“小零，你把乘法魔杖藏哪儿了？快带我去找！”彼得着急地问道。小零呱呱呱地叫了三声蹦走了，彼得赶紧跟了过去。

[P23] 很快，小零便把彼得带到了自己藏宝的地方。只见地上有 15 个洞，洞口都被封得严严实实的。彼得灵机一动，说：
“用这根除法魔杖可以把洞变少。我一定要在侏儒怪和女巫发现我们之前找到乘法魔杖。”
彼得发现这些洞正好是 5 排，每排 3 个。“15 除以 5 的话，就剩下 3 个洞……要是……” 他举起除法魔杖，对准洞口念道：“洞洞，除以 15。” 果然，地上只剩下 1 个洞了。

[P24] 突然，侏儒怪和女巫出现了。他们一把抢过彼得手中的除法魔杖。
“你真以为自己跑得了吗？”侏儒怪冷笑道，“乘法魔杖在哪儿？”
“我不知道！”彼得回答道。
“哈哈，不知道？那你跑到这儿来干什么？肯定在这个洞里！”侏儒怪叫喊着，开始在洞里挖了起来。不一会儿，他就把乘法魔杖挖了出来。
“快把我的小狗变回原样！”彼得要侏儒怪兑现承诺。

[P25] “还没到时候。”侏儒怪把刻有×的一端和÷的一端分别朝外，将两根魔杖接在了一起。只见魔杖一下子就噼里啪啦地燃烧起来，侏儒怪连忙把魔杖丢在了地上。不一会儿，火熄灭了，地上出现了一根亮闪闪的金魔杖。
侏儒怪小心地把水晶球放回刻有÷的那一端，然后举起魔杖叫起来：“我终于拥有举世无双的乘除魔法了！哈哈哈！”
这时候，女巫飞快地从侏儒怪手中抢过了金魔杖。

[P26] “你疯了？”侏儒怪冲她吼了起来，“你根本不会用这根魔杖！万一出现无效的等式，不但会毁掉魔杖，连我们的魔法也会一起消失！”他的声音里透出了一丝恐惧。
“你说过新魔杖让我先用！少啰唆！”女巫不耐烦地一脚把侏儒怪踢倒在地。
“我刚才只是说说而已……”侏儒怪嘴里咕哝着，一脸的不情愿。
“别废话，现在我们可以把整个王国变成青蛙王国了！哈哈哈！”女巫又疯狂地笑了起来。

[P27] 彼得听了他们的话，心里非常着急。怎样才能阻止他们呢？
“快滚开！”女巫忽然尖叫起来。彼得一看，小零正绕着女巫跳来跳去，还不停地用长长的舌头去舔女巫手里的魔杖。
女巫生气地四处挥舞着魔杖，“滚开！谁都别想阻止我！
“小零，快过来！”彼得喊道。就在这时，彼得忽然冒出一个想法，用一个东西除以0，是不是能让那个东西消失呢？上次就是用侏儒怪乘以0后，才把他困到“0之深渊”的。

[P28] 彼得又想了想，除法是将事物分成数量相等的几组。但是分成0组，就没有任何意义了。这会不会就是侏儒怪说的“无效的等式”呢？除以0，也许就能毁了这根魔杖！想到这儿，彼得非常激动，他决定试一试。
“玛蒂尔达，”彼得喊道，“快！用侏儒怪除以0！这样所有东西就都是你的了！”

[P29] “别听他的！”侏儒怪听到彼得的话，大惊失色。
“好主意！不过我可少不了侏儒怪。”女巫的脸上露出一丝邪恶的笑，“我有一个更好的主意。”说着她将魔杖对准小零，“小狗小狗，除以——”
“不要！”彼得大叫着朝小零冲了过去。
“不要……”侏儒怪也惊恐地尖叫起来。他伸长手臂扑向女巫，想要抓住魔杖，阻止将要发生的一切。

[P30] 可是已经来不及了！“0！”女巫大声喊道。顷刻间，魔杖爆炸了，水晶球迸裂成一团团绿色的火花。小零又变成了小狗，魔法消失了！当绿色的火花溅到侏儒怪和女巫身上时，他们立刻变成两只“青蛙怪”，一蹦一跳地逃走了。
“小零，我们成功了！”彼得抱起心爱的小狗喊起来。

[P31] 在魔杖爆炸的一瞬间，整个王国都恢复了原样。彼得打败侏儒怪和女巫玛蒂尔达的事很快就流传开来，大家纷纷向他表示感谢。国王和王后夸他是个了不起的数学魔法师，鼓励他学习更多的数学魔法。不仅如此，他们还奖励了小零一块地，让它专门藏自己的宝贝。
至于侏儒怪和女巫玛蒂尔达，他们可就惨了，还有一大堆麻烦等着他们呢！

[P32] 数学超链接
神奇的除法
除法就是把事物分成若干等份的运算方法，如6÷2=3，其中6是被除数，2是除数，3是商。
6 ÷ 2 = 3
被除数 除数 商
除以分数
既然除法是把事物分成若干等份，那为什么除以分数时，结果会比原来还要大呢？这是因为当除数是分数时，实际上把整个事物分成了若干小份。比如，把下面的这3个方框除以1/5，就是要把这3个大方框分成大小是原来的1/5的小方框，能分成几个呢？答案是15。

÷ =

3 ÷ 1/5 = 15
这种除法还有一种更为简单的计算方法，就是将被除数与除数的倒数相乘。一个数的倒数就是把它的分子和分母调换位置，如5/1是1/5的倒数。用这个方法，刚才的问题就可以这样计算：
3÷1/5=3×5/1=15

[P33] 除以 0
5 ÷ 0 = ?
也就是说，想要把5个方框分成0组，该怎么分呢？没办法分。
因此，我们通常说，除数不能为0，除数为0无意义。

[P1] I Am a Math Fan
Adventure on Emmet Island
(Area and Circumference of a Circle)
By Cindy Neuschwander (USA)
Illustrated by Wayne G. H. (USA)
American Broadcasting Company
Best Children's Book Award
American 'Learning Magazine'
Teacher-Recommended Children's Book Award
American Association for the Advancement of Science
Best Children's Book Award
Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press

[P2] I'm a Math Fan
Crystal Ball and
Division Wand
By Pam Calvert (USA)
Illustrated by Wayne Gush (USA)
Translated by Ding Wei
Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press
Beijing

[P4] "Little Zero! Little Zero!" Early in the morning, Prince Peter was searching everywhere for his little dog. This morning, Little Zero had dug up the multiplication wand, and then disappeared with it. "What if the multiplication wand falls into the hands of a bad person? The consequences would be unimaginable." Peter grew more and more anxious.
Peter passed by a farm and saw five very strange creatures grazing among the cows. These creatures looked like cows but also like frogs. One of them, a "frog-cow," even stopped and croaked when it saw Peter.
"What kind of animal is this? Could it be that the cows ate something wrong and turned into this?" Peter felt very surprised.

[P5] Just then, Peter suddenly heard a scream, "Good heavens, how did my children turn into frogs!" Peter rushed over and saw that on the road ahead, two frogs the size of children were jumping around one lady and six children.

[P6] "No, impossible... he's been imprisoned," Peter suddenly thought of the dwarf who had been causing chaos in the kingdom with the multiplication wand. He felt uneasy, hesitated for a moment, and decided to return to the castle in the royal palace first. "No matter what, I must tell Father about these strange things," Peter thought.

[P7] At the castle gate, Peter saw the 12 knights responsible for guarding the castle standing there. As he was about to go over and greet them, suddenly, the ground shook violently.
With a loud bang, 4 out of the 12 knights turned into 4 frogs wearing shiny armor!
"Could the goblin really be back?" Peter became even more puzzled and hurried into the castle.
Peter ran into the hall and saw his mother crying, with a big frog perched on her leg.

[P8] "Mother, where is Father?" Peter saw the frog and grew even more anxious.
"He... he's turned into a frog again..."
"Again?" Peter was very surprised.
"Yes, when your father was still a prince, a witch named Matilda turned him into a frog with magic. Later, a princess kissed him, and that broke the spell. I just kissed him too, but this time it didn't work."
"Wait... a princess kissed Father?"
"That was before your father met me. That story is too long to tell."

[P9] "Oh... so this time it's not the dwarf monster's doing?"
"Probably not. Look, your father's 12 ministers are preparing to set out to find
Matilda!" The queen took Peter to the balcony. The 12 ministers were mounting their horses to depart.
"Aren't there 24 ministers in total? What about the other 12?"
"They... they've turned into frogs too." The queen said, bursting into tears again.

[P10] Peter thought harder and harder, and the situation seemed more serious. If the witch used the multiplication wand, then 24 ministers multiplied by 1/2 should result in 12 ministers disappearing, not turning into frogs. How could people turn into frogs? Could it be a more evil spell? No, he must find a way to stop the witch!

[P11] Peter first came to the swamp inside the castle. There were many frogs, but they were all ordinary frogs, nothing strange about them. Just as he was about to leave, he suddenly heard a familiar, strange laugh coming from a cave nearby. Peter crept quietly toward the source of the sound.
"Matilda, your frog crystal ball is amazing! If we had only used the division magic wand, how could we have caused such a commotion?" It was the goblin's voice!
"In no time, we'll turn the entire kingdom into a frog kingdom! Hahaha!" The witch's voice was sharp and piercing.

[P12] "So it was these two who were behind it all!" Peter thought. Following the dwarf's gaze, Peter saw the witch holding a shiny crystal ball that looked very strange. The dwarf held a magic wand. This wand was like the multiplication wand, with a symbol carved on it. But it wasn't the multiplication sign ×; it was a short line with a dot above and below.
"Right! That nosy Peter actually dared to trap us in the 'Abyss of Zero'—how utterly infuriating! We'll get our revenge soon!" the dwarf cackled.
"They'll never guess that your math magic can help us escape from that cursed place," the witch said.
"When I catch that boy, I'll give him a good scolding..."

[P13] "Dwarf! We agreed, the boy is mine! Look, now witches are all into eating frog princes," the witch said, holding up a magazine in front of the dwarf. "The magazine says, frog princes are not only delicious, but also make your skin smooth and tender..."
"Don't worry. I'll hand over Prince Peter to you—right away!"
Peter hadn't even had time to react when he was suddenly pushed by the dwarf, who had appeared behind him, right in front of the witch.
Trend Magazine
A magazine specially prepared for trendsetters
The Most Delicious Frog Prince
Satisfy your appetite
Moisturize your skin
Boost your charisma

[P14] "Let me go!" Peter struggled and shouted.
"Such a temper, just like his father," the witch laughed, licking her lips. "I'm going to make him into a one-of-a-kind delicious meal."
The dwarf laughed too. "But first, I need to get something from him."
"We agreed, he's mine!" the witch complained. "Now I'm going to boil him into soup!"

"Matilda, the multiplication wand is still in his hands! If we combine it with our division wand, we'll be invincible. Then we'll have powerful multiplication and division magic, and no one can stop us!" The dwarf reluctantly added, "And then I promise you can use it first."
"Fine then!" The witch turned to Peter, glaring at him fiercely. "Now tell me! Where is the multiplication wand?"
"I won't tell you!" Peter shouted back.

[P15] "You will tell me," said the dwarf, waving his division magic wand at the crystal ball. Through the crystal ball, Peter saw Little Zero sniffing around in an alley near the castle. "Little dog, little dog, divide by one!" As soon as the words left his mouth, he saw poor Little Zero turn into a creature that looked both like a frog and a dog—a "frog-dog." "Change it back!" Peter shouted excitedly at the dwarf. "Give me the multiplication magic wand, and I'll change it back," the dwarf said.

[P16] "Don't you have a crystal ball? Why not let it tell you where the multiplication wand is?" Peter asked in return.
"My dear prince, the crystal ball can only see living things," the witch said crossly. "I'm just a witch; I can't make the impossible possible!"
"What bad thing haven't you done? You even made the cows croak," Peter muttered quietly.
Peter turned to the goblin and the witch and said, "First, take me to find Little Zero. Only it knows where the multiplication wand is."
Peter didn't want to give the multiplication wand to the goblin and the witch, but he could only think of a way to get out of there first.

[P17] "Alright!" the dwarf said, placing the crystal ball on top of the wand, "If you dare to play tricks, I'll turn you into a frog too, and you'll never change back!"

The witch giggled beside him, "Dwarf, don't scare the lovely prince!"

The three of them left the cave to find Little Zero. Along the way, the dwarf amused himself with the crystal ball and the division wand. "Butcher couple, butcher couple, divide by 2!" he said. As soon as he finished, the butcher's wife turned into a big frog, croaking at her husband.

The butcher was so frightened he nearly fainted.

[P18] A little while later, they saw a little girl playing with 12 kittens.
"Kittens, kittens, divide by 3!" shouted the dwarf. Instantly, 4 of the kittens turned into croaking "frog-kittens".
"The dwarf divides by different numbers each time. How does he know which number to divide by?" Peter wondered.
Looking at the kittens, Peter suddenly understood. 12 kittens could be divided into 3 groups of 4. The dwarf divides people or animals into equal groups, then divides the total by the number of groups, and one group turns into a "frog-creature"!

[P19] Soon, the goblin pointed the division wand at a little stable boy,
who was busy leading the horse into the stable.
"Goblin, let me try!" the witch shouted impatiently.
"You don't know how to use the division wand!" the goblin said.

[P20] The witch, without hesitation, snatched the division wand. "How hard can this be? See that horse?" She pointed the division wand at the horse and chanted, "Horse, horse, divide by 1/4!" Instantly, the horse turned into four 'frog-horses'. The tiny 'frog-horses' bounced after the horse-boy, frightening him into running away.
Peter scratched his head in confusion. Why did dividing by a fraction result in more 'frog-horses'? Soon, he realized that these four 'frog-horses' were each only 1/4 the size of the original horse.
"Give me back the division wand!" With that, the dwarf lunged at the witch.

[P21] The witch quickly jumped aside, dodging the dwarf. "I'll play a little longer!"
Saying that, she pointed the division wand at 2 little pigs and excitedly chanted: "Pig, pig, divide by 1/5!" Instantly, 10 squealing "frog pigs" appeared on the grass. The witch stared at them, drool almost dripping. "I wonder how these little things would taste stewed..."
Just as the witch was lost in thought, the dwarf snatched the crystal ball from the division wand and shouted loudly: "Stop changing them! I've had enough of these frogs!"

[P22] Seeing the crystal ball taken away, the witch angrily threw the division wand aside and shouted as she charged at the dwarf. The two quickly started fighting. Just then, Peter seized the opportunity, picked up the division wand, and fled quickly.
Peter ran all the way to the alley that had appeared in the crystal ball. There, sure enough, was Little Zero. Seeing his little master, Little Zero croaked a few times. "Little Zero, where did you hide the multiplication wand? Quickly, take me to find it!" Peter asked anxiously. Little Zero croaked three times and hopped away, and Peter hurried after him.

[P23] Soon, Xiao Ling led Peter to the place where he had hidden his treasure. There were 15 holes on the ground, each sealed tightly. Peter had a sudden idea and said:
"With this division magic wand, I can make the holes fewer. I must find the multiplication magic wand before the dwarf and the witch discover us."
Peter noticed the holes were arranged in exactly 5 rows, with 3 holes in each row. "If I divide 15 by 5, there will be 3 holes left... what if..." He raised the division magic wand, pointed it at the holes, and chanted: "Holes, divide by 15." Sure enough, only one hole remained on the ground.

[P24] Suddenly, the dwarf and the witch appeared. They snatched the division wand from Peter's hands.
"You really think you can get away?" the dwarf sneered. "Where is the multiplication wand?"
"I don't know!" Peter replied.
"Haha, don't know? Then why did you come all the way here? It must be in this hole!" the dwarf shouted, starting to dig in the hole. In no time, he dug out the multiplication wand.
"Quick, turn my little dog back to normal!" Peter demanded the dwarf to keep his promise.

[P25] "Not yet," the dwarf said, holding the ends marked with × and ÷ facing outward, and connecting the two wands together. The wands immediately burst into a crackling flame, and the dwarf quickly dropped them to the ground. In a moment, the fire died out, and a shiny golden wand appeared on the ground.
The dwarf carefully placed the crystal ball back into the end marked with ÷, then raised the wand and shouted, "I finally have the unmatched multiplication and division magic! Hahaha!"
At that moment, the witch swiftly snatched the golden wand from the dwarf's hands.

[P26] "You're crazy?" the goblin shouted at her, "You don't know how to use this wand! If an invalid equation appears, it will not only destroy the wand, but our magic will disappear too!" His voice revealed a hint of fear.
"You said I could use the new wand first! Stop nagging!" The witch impatiently kicked the goblin to the ground.
"I was just saying that..." the goblin mumbled, looking unwilling.
"Stop talking nonsense, now we can turn the entire kingdom into the Frog Kingdom! Hahaha!" The witch laughed wildly again.

[P27] Peter listened to their words and felt very anxious. How could he stop them?
"Get away!" the witch suddenly screamed. Peter looked and saw Xiao Ling jumping around the witch, constantly licking the magic wand in the witch's hand with his long tongue.
The witch angrily waved her wand around, "Get away! No one can stop me!"
"Xiao Ling, come here!" Peter shouted. At that moment, Peter suddenly had an idea: what if he divided something by 0, would it make that thing disappear? Last time, he had trapped the dwarf in the 'Abyss of Zero' by multiplying him by 0.

[P28] Peter thought again. Division means splitting things into equal groups. But dividing into 0 groups makes no sense at all. Could this be the 'invalid equation' the dwarf mentioned? Dividing by 0 might just destroy this wand! At that thought, Peter became very excited and decided to try it.
"Matilda," Peter shouted, "Quick! Divide the dwarf by 0! Then everything will be yours!"

[P29] "Don't listen to him!" The dwarf, hearing Peter's words, turned pale with shock.
"Good idea! But I can't do without the dwarf." The witch's face showed a hint of evil smile. "I have an even better idea." She pointed her wand at Little Zero, "Little dog, little dog, divide by——"
"No!" Peter shouted and rushed toward Little Zero.
"No..." The dwarf also screamed in terror. He stretched out his arms toward the witch, trying to grab the wand and stop what was about to happen.

[P30] It was too late! "0!" the witch shouted loudly. In an instant, the wand exploded and the crystal ball shattered into bursts of green sparks. Xiao Ling turned back into a puppy, and the magic disappeared! When the green sparks splashed onto the goblin and the witch, they instantly turned into two "frog monsters" and hopped away.
"Xiao Ling, we did it!" Peter cried, picking up his beloved puppy.

[P31] In the instant the wand exploded, the entire kingdom returned to normal. The story of Peter defeating the goblin and witch Matilda spread quickly, and everyone thanked him. The king and queen praised him as a remarkable math magician and encouraged him to learn more math magic. Moreover, they rewarded Little Zero with a piece of land to hide his treasures.
As for the goblin and witch Matilda, they were in for a terrible time, with a whole lot of trouble waiting for them!

[P32] Math Super Link
Amazing Division
Division is a method of dividing things into equal parts, for example, 6 ÷ 2 = 3, where 6 is the dividend, 2 is the divisor, and 3 is the quotient.
6 ÷ 2 = 3
Dividend Divisor Quotient
Dividing by a Fraction
Since division means dividing things into equal parts, why does dividing by a fraction result in a larger number? This is because when the divisor is a fraction, it actually divides the whole thing into many small parts. For example, dividing these 3 boxes by 1/5 means dividing these 3 large boxes into small boxes that are 1/5 the size of the original. How many can you get? The answer is 15.

÷ =

3 ÷ 1/5 = 15
There is also a simpler method for this kind of division: multiply the dividend by the reciprocal of the divisor. The reciprocal of a number is obtained by swapping its numerator and denominator. For example, 5/1 is the reciprocal of 1/5. Using this method, the previous problem can be calculated as follows:
3 ÷ 1/5 = 3 × 5/1 = 15

[P33] Dividing by 0
5 ÷ 0 = ?
That is to say, if you want to divide 5 boxes into 0 groups, how can you do it? It's impossible.
Therefore, we usually say that the divisor cannot be 0, and dividing by 0 is meaningless.

[P1] 本页为绘本《艾默特岛探险》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、出版社及所获奖项，画面描绘了城堡和几位角色围坐桌旁的场景。
[P2] 本页为绘本《水晶球与除法魔杖》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者、出版社及系列标识，画面描绘了一个手持魔杖的孩子与一只绿色小怪物奔跑的场景。
[P3] 画面中，一个穿着蓝色背心和棕色短裤的男孩正沿着弯曲的土路行走，路边有石墙和几头花牛，一只黑猫在石墙旁注视着他。
[P4] 彼得王子在寻找他的小狗小零，担心小零刨出的乘法魔杖落入坏人之手。他路过一个农场，发现奶牛群中有五只像奶牛又像青蛙的奇怪生物，其中一只还叫了一声，让他感到非常惊讶。
[P5] 彼得听到尖叫声后跑过去，发现有两只孩子大小的青蛙正在围着一位女士和六个孩子跳来跳去。
[P6] 彼得王子在目睹了青蛙状生物围攻女士和孩子们的怪事后，意识到可能是被囚禁的侏儒怪作祟，决定先回王宫城堡向父亲报告此事。
[P7] 彼得在城堡门前发现四名骑士变成了穿盔甲的青蛙，他怀疑是侏儒怪作祟，急忙跑进城堡，发现母亲正在大厅里哭泣，腿上还趴着一只大青蛙。
[P8] 彼得王子在城堡内发现母亲腿上趴着一只青蛙，焦急地询问父亲下落，母亲解释父亲曾被女巫变成青蛙，后被公主亲吻解除魔法，但这次亲吻无效，暗示父亲再次被施法。
[P9] 彼得王子和王后在阳台上，王后向他解释父亲的12位大臣正准备出发寻找玛蒂尔达，但另外12位大臣也变成了青蛙，王后因此再次哭泣。
[P10] 彼得王子在阳台上思考，意识到女巫可能使用了更邪恶的魔法，将大臣们变成了青蛙，而非让他们消失，他决心阻止女巫。
[P11] 彼得来到城堡内的沼泽地，发现那里只有普通青蛙，但听到洞穴中传来熟悉的怪笑，他悄悄靠近，听到了侏儒怪和女巫的对话，得知他们正计划用魔法将整个王国变成青蛙王国。
[P12] 彼得王子在沼泽地的洞穴中偷听到侏儒怪和女巫的对话，得知他们正计划用数学魔法从‘0之深渊’逃脱，并打算报复彼得，将整个王国变成青蛙王国。
[P13] 女巫向侏儒怪展示一本宣传青蛙王子美味的杂志，承诺将彼得王子交给侏儒怪，随后侏儒怪将彼得推到女巫面前。
[P14] 彼得王子被女巫和侏儒怪抓住，女巫想把他做成美食，侏儒怪想先得到乘法魔杖，彼得拒绝透露魔杖下落。
[P15] 侏儒怪用除法魔杖将小零变成了一只“青蛙狗”，彼得焦急地要求他变回去，侏儒怪则以此为条件，要求彼得交出乘法魔杖。
[P16] 彼得王子被女巫和侏儒怪抓住，他质问为何不用水晶球找乘法魔杖，女巫解释水晶球只能看到有生命的东西。彼得小声抱怨女巫的恶行，并提出先去找小零，因为只有小零知道魔杖下落，他暂时不想交出魔杖，只能想办法脱身。
[P17] 侏儒怪和女巫抓住彼得王子后，用魔法戏弄一对屠夫夫妇，将妻子变成青蛙，屠夫吓得几乎昏厥，三人随后出发去找小零。
[P18] 侏儒怪用除法魔法将12只小猫中的4只变成了“青蛙猫”，彼得王子观察后明白了侏儒怪的魔法原理：将总数平均分组，再用总数除以组数，其中一组就会被变成青蛙怪。
[P19] 侏儒怪用除法魔杖瞄准一个小马童，女巫要求自己试试，但被侏儒怪拒绝，认为她不会使用魔杖。
[P20] 女巫抢过除法魔杖，将一匹马变成四匹缩小的“青蛙马”，彼得王子观察后理解了魔法原理，侏儒怪随即向女巫扑去抢回魔杖。
[P21] 女巫用除法魔杖将两只小猪变成了十只青蛙小猪，并流口水想着炖汤，侏儒怪趁她出神时抢回水晶球，大喊不要再变青蛙了。
[P22] 女巫与侏儒怪因争夺水晶球而打斗，彼得趁机夺回除法魔杖并逃走，随后赶到水晶球所示的小巷，找到小零并急切询问乘法魔杖的下落，小零带路，彼得紧跟其后。
[P23] 彼得在小零的带领下找到藏宝地，发现地上有15个被封住的洞，他用除法魔杖将洞的数量从15个减少到1个。
[P24] 侏儒怪和女巫出现并抢走彼得的除法魔杖，逼问乘法魔杖下落。彼得不知情，侏儒怪便在洞中挖掘，最终挖出乘法魔杖，并被彼得要求兑现将小狗变回原样的承诺。
[P25] 侏儒怪将乘法魔杖与除法魔杖连接，成功合体为一根金魔杖，并宣称拥有乘除魔法，但女巫随即抢走了这根新魔杖。
[P26] 女巫抢到新魔杖后，侏儒怪警告她使用不当会毁掉魔杖和魔法，但女巫不听劝阻，一脚将侏儒怪踢倒，并狂笑宣称要将整个王国变成青蛙王国。
[P27] 彼得看到小零在女巫身边跳来跳去并舔她的魔杖，女巫愤怒地挥舞魔杖，彼得灵机一动，想到用除以0的方法来让魔杖消失，以阻止女巫。
[P28] 彼得想到用除以0的方法来破坏女巫手中的魔杖，他大声喊话，让女巫对侏儒怪执行除以0的魔法，试图借此让魔杖失效。
[P29] 女巫准备用魔杖对小零施加“除以”魔法，彼得和侏儒怪惊恐地试图阻止她，画面中三人紧张对峙，侏儒怪伸手扑向女巫的魔杖。
[P30] 女巫使用魔杖时，魔杖因除以0而爆炸，魔法失效，小零变回小狗，女巫和侏儒怪被变成青蛙怪逃走，彼得成功救回小狗并欢呼庆祝。
[P31] 魔杖爆炸后，王国恢复原状，彼得因打败侏儒怪和女巫而受到国王和王后的嘉奖，并获得学习更多数学魔法的鼓励；小零也得到一块地作为奖励。而侏儒怪和女巫则面临一大堆麻烦。
[P32] 本页为数学知识拓展页，解释了除法的概念、除以分数的原理及其计算方法，并通过图形和算式进行了说明。
[P33] 本页为数学知识拓展页，通过文字和插图解释了除以0的概念，说明除数不能为0，因为将物品分成0组在逻辑上无法实现。
